name: quarto-chromium
description: Installs Chromium runtime for Quarto HTML/PDF rendering

postInstallCheck.command: sh -c 'command -v chromium >/dev/null 2>&1 || command -v chromium-browser >/dev/null 2>&1 || find ${HOME}/.local/share/quarto/chromium ${HOME}/.quarto ${HOME}/.local/share/quarto-chromium \( -type f -o -type l \) \( -name chrome -o -name chromium -o -name chromium-browser -o -name headless_shell \) -print -quit 2>/dev/null | grep -q .'
postInstallCheck.description: Verify Chromium is available for Quarto rendering
